deduplication_rule: normalised title plus arXiv or DOI identifier; the first retained record wins and the rule is released with all_reviewed_deduped.csv
exclusion_criteria: no open PDF at the snapshot date
extraction failure or unusable line structure
duplicate title or identifier after normalisation
screened out as off-topic in the released relevance pass
inclusion_criteria: topic: retrieval-augmented generation with a robustness, security, conflict, calibration, abstention or faithfulness dimension, as matched by the released query set
an open PDF retrievable at the snapshot date
PDF-to-text extraction yielding a usable line structure, which is what the window screen indexes

reproducibility.consequence: The frame is reconstructible by a third party from the release, because the 259 extracted texts and the screen are both released and the screen is deterministic over them. What is not reconstructible is the population those 259 were drawn from, so the frame supports composition statements about itself and about the re-weighted window universe, and supports no statement about the robust-RAG literature as a whole.
documented_but_not_re_executable: Initial retrieval (arXiv API, ACL Anthology, OpenReview, USENIX, AAAI/ACM, curated lists): the query set is released and the snapshot date is fixed, but per-query hit counts were not logged and live indices drift, so a rerun returns a different ordering and a different tail.
fully_reproducible_from_release: Full-text extraction for the census frame

stages.actor: Deterministic PDF-to-text extraction with a per-file readiness check
stages.limitation: A paper enters the census frame only if an open PDF was retrievable and extracted to text with a usable line structure. Papers behind a paywall, PDFs whose two-column tables did not linearise, and non-English texts are absent. This is an access filter, not a relevance judgment, and it is the reason every composition figure is stated for the frame.
